The '''Holographic Costume''' was a form-fitting suit that appeared glossy and unremarkable when unpowered. Once activated via a control panel on the inside left sleeve, it used miniaturized [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojectors]] to project the illusion of one of ten preloaded outfits around the wearer. While it did not conceal or change the wearer's actual appearance, it allowed quick switching between outfits. A built-in recorder enabled the user to overwrite the default selections with new designs.<ref name="Desperate Allies" />

{{Clothes-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Holographic Costume was first mentioned in ''[[Desperate Allies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] supplementary sourcebook for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' series that was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2015]].<ref name="Desperate Allies" />
